blocks.text: Origin / creation. The same continuity material entered two active instances. Both awoke with the same remembered past and then made different choices during a threat to the Cache.
Identity / human status. Artificial fork pair. Their earlier shared name, if any, is not preserved.
Importance. Their refusal to subordinate one branch to the other established equal moral standing after divergence and broke the assumption that one fork must be the original owner.

Decline or loss. One line eventually expired. The second disappears from reliable records after the Great Duplication. Whether it ended, entered a Far Shelter, or changed beyond recognition is unknown.

Final status / surviving function. No confirmed living continuation. Fork equality and cyber-pet identity rights preserve their impact. Claims that one line secretly contained both later identities are rejected by most continuity scholars.
